page.overview:
Who is B'ree?

B'ree was a Rodian male weapons merchant who lived on the Outer Rim Sith world of Korriban during the Jedi Civil War between the Galactic Republic and Sith Empire. He ran a kiosk in the settlement of Dreshdae, at which he sold weapons. In 3956 BBY, his sales increased after a power struggle at Dreshdae's Sith Academy.

During the Jedi Civil War, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, B'ree lived on the Sith controlled planet of Korriban. B'ree owned a kiosk near a landing pad in Dreshdae, a settlement on the planet. The majority of his stock consisted of arms brought to him through Mandalorian raider contacts he maintained. The Sith were dangerous, so B'ree encouraged newcomers to purchase his weaponry for defense.

Later in the same year, former Dark Lord of the Sith Revan, who had lost his memories and retrained as a Jedi, arrived on Korriban during his search for the Star Forge. Revan approached the Rodian, who recognized the former as the champion of the Ahto City swoop track, located on the Inner Rim waterworld of Manaan. B'ree discussed his stock and opinions on the Sith. The Jedi later infiltrated the Sith Academy on the planet, killing Sith Master Uthar Wynn and redeeming his apprentice, Yuthura Ban. With no leaders, the Academy fell into a power struggle, causing B'ree's sales to increase drastically, a fact he later mentioned to Revan.

B'ree was a male Rodian with copper-colored skin and black eyes. He viewed the Sith as obnoxious but understood that they were dangerous. The Rodian thus attempted to sell his weapons to newcomers of Korriban, to help them defend themselves. The Rodian was not shy about sharing his opinion on the Sith, even to strangers. B'ree believed that trouble was good for his business, especially when caused by the Sith.
